name: Navigate the animated personalized portfolio
description: Verifies the main portfolio navigation reaches the personalized sections and the updated social links are present.
steps: Select Projects from the floating navigation
expected: Projects, Skills, Experience, and Contact scroll into view and the portfolio uses the personalized social destinations without an X link.

name: Verify portrait, subtle Open to Work motion, and scroll navigation
description: Verifies the supplied profile image is shown in a fixed circular frame while the Open to Work badge uses restrained motion and has no circulating decorative ball.
steps: Open the portfolio at the top
Move the pointer across the profile image
Observe the Open to Work badge
expected: The profile image remains fixed in its circular frame, the Open to Work badge moves only subtly without a circulating ball, pointer effects respond, and navigation hides downward and returns upward.

name: Use the mobile menu and open the contact form
description: Verifies the mobile contact workflow opens an in-page message form instead of launching a desktop email application.
steps: Open the site on a mobile viewport
expected: The mobile menu opens, Contact is reached, and Get in Touch opens a message form inside the portfolio.

name: Validate the contact form before sending
description: Verifies the contact modal contains required fields and clearly identifies the destination email before a message is submitted.
steps: Enter a name, email, subject, and message
expected: The browser blocks an incomplete submission, the form identifies shariqofficial6@gmail.com as the recipient, and a complete form submits to the secure backend email route without opening Outlook.

name: Expand the resume project list
description: Verifies project cards remain interactive and the Show All Projects control reveals all five resume-derived projects.
steps: Confirm project cards show images and project tags
expected: Project cards animate on hover and all five projects become visible.
